# Recreation Prompt

Recreate Void Runner: Prism Protocol as a portrait-first browser arcade endless runner. Preserve the source mechanic truth: one tap or Space sets a fixed upward velocity, gravity pulls the runner down, hazards and collectibles scroll left, rectangle overlap collects or fails, each collectible adds one score, every five score increases scroll speed by 0.5, and top/bottom bounds fail. Rebuild the presentation as a satirical cyber-y2k synthwave void where a prism-board runner collects W Rizz Shards and dodges Boredom Walls. Use Canvas for gameplay and procedural art, Orbitron/Rajdhani/Press Start 2P for UI, compact mobile panels, clear CTAs, and catalog-approved sci-fi audio for optional feedback. Do not add new mechanics or alter scoring/failure semantics.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: one-button side-scrolling arcade runner with Flappy-style vertical control
- objective: stay alive while collecting score items that move from right to left
- input model: tap/click on the canvas or press Space to apply an upward lift; menu buttons use normal click/tap
- core loop: start from menu, enter a short tap-to-drop cutscene, pulse upward against gravity, avoid rectangular hazards and screen bounds, collect small items for score, continue as speed rises
- fail/friction state: touching a non-collectible obstacle or leaving the vertical playfield triggers game over with final score and restart/menu options

## Protected mechanics
- One-thumb/Space pulse input sets the player vertical velocity to a fixed lift value.
- Gravity continuously pulls the player downward during active play.
- Obstacles and collectibles spawn on timers and scroll left at the current game speed.
- Axis-aligned rectangle overlap decides collectible pickup or hazard failure.
- Each collectible increases score by one.
- Every five collected items increases horizontal game speed by 0.5.
- Boundary contact at top or bottom is a fail state.
- Start, cutscene, playing, game-over, restart, and menu state flow remains intact.

## Remixed target
Void Runner: Prism Protocol reframes the preserved arcade runner as a satirical cyber-y2k void sprint. The player is a prism-board runner surfing through a synthwave boredom machine, collecting W Rizz shards while dodging corporate Boredom Walls. Presentation, HUD language, procedural background, feedback, and media shift aggressively while the actual tap, gravity, collision, scoring, speed escalation, and failure semantics stay faithful.
